# ToolVerse (`https://toolverse.baby/`)

> ToolVerse is a privacy-first web application platform providing 100+ free online utility tools (PDF converters, image compressors, barcode generators, tax calculators, SEO tools) and a Global Multi-Country Job Finder indexing over 1,000 active vacancies. All file processing runs 100% locally inside client browser memory using HTML5 Canvas & WebAssembly (WASM) without uploading files to remote servers.

## Core Features & Verticals

- [Global Job Finder Engine](https://toolverse.baby/tools/global-job-finder): Browse 1,000+ active jobs across USA, Pakistan, UAE, UK, and remote global vacancies.
- [Compress Image to Target Size](https://toolverse.baby/tools/compress-image-target-size): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP photos to exact file sizes (20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 1MB) for job portals and official forms.
- [Free Barcode Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/barcode-generator): Generate printable Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, and ITF-14 vector barcodes.
- [Merge PDF Files Privately](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pdf-merge): Combine multiple PDF documents locally inside browser memory.
- [Pakistan Salary Tax Estimator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/pakistan-salary-tax-estimator): Calculate monthly net income and FBR salary tax deductions.
- [Free QR Code Generator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/qr-code-generator): Create SVG and PNG QR codes for WiFi, links, and text.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://toolverse.baby/tools/zakat-calculator): Calculate Zakat obligation on gold, silver, cash, and investments.
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://toolverse.baby/tools/heic-to-jpg): Convert Apple iPhone HEIC images to standard JPG format.
- [HEIC to JPG on Windows guide](https://toolverse.baby/blog/convert-heic-to-jpg-windows-iphone): Practical conversion + KB compression workflow.

## Documentation & Guides

- [ToolVerse SEO & Career Blog](https://toolverse.baby/blog): Articles on remote job hunting, WebAssembly browser privacy, barcode standards, image compression, and taxation.
